description: This file defines the public API for PCIe Endpoint (EP) drivers in Zephyr, including enums, callback types, and inline functions for configuration, address mapping, interrupt handling, and data transfer.

methods.name: pcie_ep_conf_read
methods.description: Reads the PCIe EP configuration space at a specified offset.

methods.name: pcie_ep_conf_write
methods.description: Writes data to the PCIe EP configuration space at a specified offset.

methods.name: pcie_ep_map_addr
methods.description: Maps a host memory buffer to a PCIe outbound region.

methods.name: pcie_ep_unmap_addr
methods.description: Removes a mapping to a PCIe outbound region.

methods.name: pcie_ep_raise_irq
methods.description: Raises an interrupt to the host.

methods.name: pcie_ep_register_reset_cb
methods.description: Registers a callback for PCIe reset interrupts.

methods.name: pcie_ep_xfer_data_memcpy
methods.description: Transfers data between host and device memory using memcpy.

methods.name: pcie_ep_xfer_data_dma
methods.description: Transfers data between host and device memory using system DMA.
